attrs.remaining_trust: The mutation-surface check is a SOURCE SCAN. It finds assignments whose target is a `bal` subscript and reports their enclosing function; it would miss a write through an aliased reference, a computed property name, or a helper in another module. Those three are now open undermining defeaters against the instrument rather than a sentence at the bottom of this record. GPT-5.6's audit ranks the source scan the weakest of three options and it is taken knowingly: refactoring the guarded writes behind one private primitive is the strong fix and it is a kernel change this round does not make.
attrs.rule: structural induction over the mutation surface: if one guard mediates every balance write in the quantified operation set, a property of the guard is a property of the set
